question: Should generic tool-progress intent be a permanent public Plugin SDK contract, or remain a narrower bundled Codex-to-channel seam?
rationale: The branch adds third-party API surface; source correctness cannot determine the intended permanent plugin contract or its supported producer and channel semantics.

options.title: Approve and document public intent
options.body: Keep the generic marker and predicate, define their producer and channel semantics in public Plugin SDK documentation, and lock them with focused contract tests.

options.title: Use a narrower bundled seam
options.body: Remove the public exports and carry progress intent through an approved internal or bundled-plugin boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve and document public intent
recommendation.body: Keep the generic marker and predicate, define their producer and channel semantics in public Plugin SDK documentation, and lock them with focused contract tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The history connects this person to both Slack delivery and public Plugin SDK reply-payload decisions.
